system.description:
(Smash)

Put everything into the swing with a melee weapon that has the Heavy trait, held in two hands.

  • Trade your usual precision for a strike that lands like a falling tree — roll the attack with Disadvantage (any Advantage you would have on it is ignored, so it can never cancel the Disadvantage), but if it connects, roll one extra weapon damage die and add it to the damage (two extra dice from 10th level).
  • It cannot be combined on the same attack with another option that gives your own attack Disadvantage (Shield Blow).

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

rules.value: Power Attack: on a hit add one extra weapon damage die (two from 10th level).
